title: Shared planning helpers are reachable without the input guards their public wrappers apply
outcome: Shared planning helpers are reachable without the input guards their public wrappers apply
acceptance: Self-prerequisite, children-list bounds, unique local keys and priority range are enforced inside the shared helpers, the ancestor walk carries its own visited set or names the invariant it depends on, and refusal texts interpolate their constants

completion.summary: Shared planning transitions enforce pure root, decomposition and prerequisite input guards before writes while preserving public refusal order and atomic-plan semantics; direct tests prove unchanged transaction state on refusal, constant-based diagnostics and valid boundaries.
